requirements.summary: Flyback diode D1 (1N4148W) is wired backwards across relay coil K1: anode (pin 2) on +5V and cathode (pin 1) on /COIL_N. When Q1 saturates, /COIL_N drops to ~0 V and D1 conducts forward from +5V straight to GND through Q1, shorting the HLK-PM01 output and destroying D1 (and then leaving the coil with no flyback clamp). Cathode must go to +5V. The PCB is inconsistent with this too: DRC reports D1 pads shorted to tracks of the other net. U1 (AMS1117) SOT-223 pinout matches the datasheet (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN). Q1 SS8050 BEC, PS1 and ESP-12F pinouts cannot be checked because those datasheets are not in the bundle (the ESP datasheets provided are for ESP-WROOM-02/ESP8266EX, not ESP-12F).

requirements.summary: The ESP8266 straps sit at the levels needed for flash boot: GPIO15 is pulled down by R5 (10k to GND); GPIO2 is pulled up by R4 and GPIO0 by R3 (10k to +3V3, with SW1 or J3 pulling it low for download); EN is pulled up by R1 with a 100 nF RC (C7); RST is pulled up by R2 with C8. This matches the Espressif strapping table. The table quoted comes from the ESP-WROOM-02 datasheet (same ESP8266EX chip), because no ESP-12F datasheet is in the bundle.

requirements.summary: Because D1 is reversed, every time the relay turns on (Q1 on) the +5V rail is shorted to GND through D1 and Q1. This overloads PS1 (HLK-PM01) and is far beyond the 1N4148W's forward rating, so the 5 V source cannot supply its load. Otherwise, the AMS1117 sees 5 V against a 15 V absolute maximum and has 1.7 V of headroom (it needs at least 1.5 V), which is fine. PS1's current budget cannot be confirmed because there is no HLK-PM01 datasheet.

evidence.quote: it shorts the supply when the switch turns on

requirements.summary: F1 (T500mA) and RV1 protect only the PS1 branch (L_IN -> F1 -> L_F -> PS1/RV1). The switched load path L_IN -> K1 -> L_OUT has no fuse on the board, so a load fault is protected only by the upstream breaker; the relay is rated 16 A. RV1 is a 07D221K (220 V varistor voltage, about 140 VAC continuous). If the board is used on 230 VAC mains, which the 250 V fuse rating suggests, this varistor will conduct at line peaks and fail or blow F1. A 07D471K-class part would be needed for 230 VAC. The mains voltage is not stated in the requirements.

The pull-ups, the base drive (R6 1k, R7 10k pull-down) and the LED resistors (R8 1k, R9 220R) are reasonable. However, the AMS1117 datasheet asks for a 22 µF solid tantalum output capacitor for stability, and C4 is a 22 µF ceramic in 0805, whose ESR may be too low for this LDO. RV1 07D221K is undersized for 230 VAC (see MOD-PROT-001). D1's value is right, but it is fitted in the wrong orientation.

requirements.summary: The U1 SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprint matches the AMS1117 SOT-223 pinout (tab = VOUT). K1 is a G5RL-1A-E-HR placed on the Relay_SPST_Omron_G2RL-1A-E footprint, and U2 is an ESP-12F on the ESP-12E footprint. These are plausible equivalents, but neither can be checked without the G5RL and ESP-12F datasheets, which are not in the bundle. There are also no datasheets for SS8050, HLK-PM01, the TS-1187A buttons or the fuse. On the PCB, D1's pads are now cross-connected to tracks of the opposite net, so the D1 orientation and routing on the board are wrong.

extra_findings.text: error: The PCB around D1 has 3 shorting_items and 3 solder_mask_bridge DRC errors (+5V to /COIL_N) and 2 unrouted connections. The board as routed would short the 5 V rail to the coil node even without powering the relay. It must be re-routed once the diode orientation is fixed.

evidence.quote: Items shorting two nets (nets +5V and /COIL_N) (Track [+5V] on F.Cu, length 2.9698 mm; Pad 1 [/COIL_N] of D1 on F.Cu)

extra_findings.text: warning: Pin 2 of programming header J3 ties the programmer's +5V directly onto the HLK-PM01 output rail. Powering the board from both at once back-feeds one supply into the other. There is no isolation between this low-voltage header and a board carrying live mains, so programming must only be done with mains disconnected.

warning: The bundle only has datasheets for ESP-WROOM-02 and ESP8266EX, not for the ESP-12F that is actually used. There are also no local datasheets for HLK-PM01, G5RL relay, SS8050 or 1N4148W, so their ratings and pinouts were not checked.
